title: terminal: ED2 at a prompt skips blank rows when finding the prompt
body:
`ESC [ 2 J` scrolls the screen into scrollback instead of erasing it when the last non-empty row of the active area is a prompt, so that ^L at a prompt keeps the prior output (#905). Since the row semantic prompt state was reduced to none/prompt/prompt_continuation, blank rows and command output rows are both `.none`, and the search stopped at the first blank row below the prompt. The heuristic therefore only worked when the prompt was on the last row of the screen.

Skip rows without text while searching upward so that only a non-empty row without prompt cells ends the search.

Fixes: #14660
Discussion: #14659

AI disclosure: Claude Code was used in the preparation of this PR.
